data.title: Industrial Automation
data.tagline: Control architecture, robotics, and line integration engineered for uptime.
data.overview: Meridian designs and commissions automation systems that connect machines, safety, and production data into one dependable operating layer. We work backwards from the process: cycle time, quality, and maintainability come before hardware selection.

image.alt: Industrial robotic arm on an engineering bench

data.title: Smart Manufacturing
data.tagline: Traceability, OEE, and quality intelligence built on the plant floor.
data.overview: We turn production data into operating decisions. Our teams connect machines, quality systems, and people with a data model that reflects how the plant actually runs — then prove the value on one line before scaling.

image.alt: Automotive assembly line in a modern factory

data.title: Industrial Software
data.tagline: Operational platforms that turn machine data into decisions.
data.overview: We build focused operational software where off-the-shelf tools stop short: production portals, quality workflows, asset registers, and integration layers. Every interface is designed for the shift, not for a demo.

data.title: Infrastructure Engineering
data.tagline: Resilient electrical, utility, and facility systems for critical operations.
data.overview: From load studies to commissioning, we engineer the physical systems that keep production and services running. Our work is judged by resilience, maintainability, and a handover package the client's own team can operate.

image.alt: Container cranes above stacked shipping containers

data.title: Digital Transformation
data.tagline: A practical route from fragmented systems to a connected operation.
data.overview: Transformation fails when it starts with technology. We help leadership sequence change around a clear operating problem, then deliver the data, systems, and habits that make the change durable.

data.title: System Integration
data.tagline: One accountable team across vendors, protocols, and sites.
data.overview: We take responsibility for the seams. Meridian coordinates vendors, designs the integration layer, tests the whole system, and stays accountable when something does not behave as specified.
